profile.headline: Release Manager at Microsoft, Azure Specialized/HPC
profile.summary: I specialize in release engineering and deployment orchestration for Azure services, with a focus on safe regional buildout, production rollout automation, and global cloud expansion. My recent work has centered on EV2-based deployment modernization, new-cloud onboarding, staged rollout design, and reducing manual operational risk across Azure infrastructure. I’m interested in platform efforts that make deployments faster, safer, more measurable.

positions.title: Release Manager / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Drive Azure Batch new-cloud and regional buildout efforts, partnering with Buildout automation, Global Expansion, and Azure partner teams to streamline global Azure expansion.
 • Lead EV2-based deployment orchestration for Azure Batch infrastructure and service rollouts across Public and sovereign clouds.
 • Modernize legacy deployment workflows into region-agnostic, pipeline-driven rollout patterns that improve repeatability, auditability, and operational safety.
 • Design staged rollout and validation flows that reduce deployment risk, isolate blast radius, and support faster mitigation or rollback.
 • Partner across service teams to resolve deployment blockers, align regional readiness, and sequence high-risk changes through safe rollout waves.
 • Build PowerShell, Azure DevOps, OneBranch, and CloudBuild automation to reduce manual release work and standardize operational procedures.
 • Own capacity-planning and regional-readiness inputs for Azure Batch service expansion.
 • Contribute to long-term deployment architecture decisions for safer, faster production saturation across global Azure environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported post-acquisition engineering and IT integration for an acquired product team.
 • Migrated engineering infrastructure and source/build systems to meet Microsoft security, compliance, and operational requirements.
 • Assisted team members with onboarding, desktop support, and transition into Microsoft engineering processes.
 • Acted as liaison between the acquired team and Microsoft integration partners to resolve infrastructure and workflow blockers.
 • Previously delivered a portable Linux agent component linked against MUSL C libraries; portions were open sourced and contributed back to Chef Omnibus packaging.
 • Helped adapt acquired engineering systems, build processes, and source control workflows into Microsoft engineering standards.
 • Led a software engineering team through delivery of a generally available Microsoft-branded product.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
* Spearheaded compliance and remediation efforts pertaining to information security and software licensing to facilitate our startup's acquisition.
* Added an Unix binary `strip` feature to Chef's Omnibus product to facilitate stripping debugging symbols on native C binaries, and shipping smaller pre-compiled packages.
* Manage and maintain Cycle Computing's public-facing, and internal software engineering, infrastructure.
* Establish and codify information security best-practices for supporting customer, and internal business, requirements.
* Improve QA process by expanding automated test coverage in the internal integration testing suite.
* Assist Solution Engineers with Chef automation development per customer needs.
* Package Cycle Computing's, and partner's, software to facilitate faster resource provisioning for customer HPC workloads.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
* Package Cycle Computing's, and partner's, software to facilitate faster resource provisioning for customer HPC workloads.
* Manage and maintain Continuous Integration and Software Configuration Management processes and services.
* Develop, and automate, integration testing suite for Cycle Server product.

positions.title: Senior Linux Administrator
positions.description:
* Manage and maintain a large installation of DNS and E-mail infrastructure in a mixed Linux/Windows environment.
 * Develop best practices for deployment and provisioning of virtual and physical resources.
 * Maintains several complex and critical server systems such as Oracle database back-ends.
 * Work towards continually improving and integrating systems by applying DevOps principles: developing infrastructure as code; automating repetition; measuring and monitoring performance of critical systems; sharing the results and learning from these practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Network Engineering · Powershell

positions.title: IT Contractor - Windows Server Administrator
positions.description:
* Automate collection of inventory, and document Eastern division's server assets.
* Document and organize a large scale print server migration for the Eastern division.
* Securely de-commission end-of-life server and storage system hardware and prepare systems for donation to local non-profit organization.
* Perform backup management duties including documentation and off-site tape rotation.
* Automate administrative tasks with Perl and VBScript including inventory collection, storage system benchmarking, and GIS data file processing.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
* Small to mid-size Business IT consulting and solution implementation.
* Designed, deployed, and managed embedded Linux-based firewall/Intrusion Prevention solutions.
 - Active Snort signature developer in conjunction with Bleeding Snort community.
* Participated in Information Security incident responses for small to enterprise business environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Network Engineering · Powershell

positions.title: Student Systems Programmer
positions.description:
* Assisted in the setup and operation of a 12 county video conference, a virtual "Town Hall Meeting" for Congressman Nick Joe Rahall.
* Implemented Linux based firewall system to mitigate the spread of the Sasser worm and isolate infections.
* Implemented and managed Snort signature-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems for student, faculty and WVNet networks.
* Set up and managed several LAMP stack web servers for central IT and Math department.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Network Engineering

honors.title: Awesome Community Chef 2014
honors.description: Recognized as one, out of four, outstanding contributors to Chef Open Source community.

honors.title: Grand prize winner - Opscode Chef Cookbook Contest
honors.description: Awarded grand prize in Open Source community programming contest for a set of configuration management modules covering iSCSI, Multipath I/O, and Oracle system components.

projects.title: Opscode Chef
projects.description:
Opscode Chef is an Open Source configuration management project with a focus on fully automated infrastructure.

My own contributions to this project include supporting new community members, and maintaining cookbook modules.

projects.title: Emerging Threats Snort community
projects.description:
Formerly known as the Bleeding Edge Threats.  This Open Source community exists to create, share, and improve community Snort rules as new emerging threats are identified in the wild.

During my time working with this project I contributed Snort signatures, and development feedback, towards the Emerging Threats rule set.
